CA.rationale: A (attention) is absent, so no C+A binding possible.

COD.rationale: For each binding, content (color coordinate listing), an organization/presentation (the coordinate listing as presented), and a distinct status/origin entry are present with matching referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to the content's organization or access is stated; candidate labels and origin metadata do not constitute attention.

C.rationale: Text explicitly lists identified contents with color attributes (red/blue) and coordinate sets for specific referents and times.

D.rationale: The report separately records origin/status metadata (origin/inherited_current/history_estimate) distinct from the coordinate content entries for the same referents/times.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are represented/presented as organized coordinate patterns for given referents and times (current and candidate states).
